what: Every job of agent_job.py gets a name its title starts with ("Alma: Release 2.29"): --name, else the next free one of a built-in list of neutral first names; --parent ID makes it a part job ("Alma B") whose result names its leader (job_parent with job_id; the job keeps it); older servers that refuse job_parent get the same message without it. The app shows the name on the job's messages and derives the job's colour from it (a part job: its leader's, lighter)
